notes.title: 10th Game Update - Milestone
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
60 days ago I released VolleySmash (right after releasing my other game: Back 4 more, within the same month)

I've been busy doing freelancing jobs while also making sure I fix, add, improve on both games 
(Mainly VolleySmash)
Which I'm happy to have reached this 10th update!

The game has improved alot from the past updates; 
-A new control and input systems
-Gameplay optimizations
-Menus and navigation optimizations & improvements
-Menus Visuals improvements and polish
-Additional Gameplay content
-Additional Music soundtracks
-Additional environments
-AI improvements
-SFX & VFX improvements
-Bug fixes
